import random

seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 8)
q = rng.randint(1, 8)
lines = [f"{n} {q}"]
for _ in range(n):
    lines.append("".join(rng.choice("abc") for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4))))
for _ in range(q):
    lines.append("".join(rng.choice("abc") for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5))))
print("\n".join(lines))
